en.answer: In this case, even if <<5880>> is no longer face-up on the field when its effect resolves, the effect is applied normally.
en.question: If the first effect of <<5880>> is activated during the End Phase, but <<5432>> or <<5914>> are chained so that <<5880>> is no longer face-up on the field when its effect resolves, does the effect apply?
en.title: If the first effect of <<5880>> is activated during the End Phase, but <<5432>> or <<5914>> are chained so that <<5880>> is no longer face-up on the field when its effect resolves, does the effect apply?

ja.answer:
＜以下のルールは、2015年4月1日より適用されます＞
エンドフェイズに発動した「<<5880>>」の効果にチェーンして「<<5432>>」や「<<5914>>」の効果が発動し、「<<5880>>」自身がフィールドに表側表示で存在しなくなった場合でも、発動した効果の処理は通常通り適用されます。
